memory_candidates.content: CSLib checkInitImports distinction: `weak.linter.checkInitImports` is disabled in lakefile.toml (incompatibility with current setup), but `lake exe checkInitImports` (standalone executable) is still active and required by CI. Always run the exe, not just lake build.

CSLib BibKey naming convention: CamelCase format (`Blackburn2001`, `ChagrovZakharyaschev1997`) not mathlib lowercase (`bourbaki1966`). Format: concatenate author surnames then append year. BibKeys resolve to entries in root `references.bib`.
